editorial:
Imagine you are an ex-con just trying to find your brother, only to stumble into a massive corporate cover-up. That is exactly what happens to Hank Rogers. He is a tough guy with a heart of gold who gets caught up with a greedy group of executives. These crooks are trying to hide the fact that their company president is dead so they can steal his money and power. Along the way, Hank teams up with the dead man's daughter, Audrey, to take these villains down. It has that classic old-school detective vibe where the stakes feel high and the characters are sharp.

You will likely love how the mystery unfolds and how Hank uses his street smarts to outwit the rich guys. The acting is solid, and the story moves quickly without getting bogged down. While some of the plots might feel a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of noir films, it is still a blast to watch. It is a great pick for a weekend binge.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Hank and Audrey finally gather enough evidence to prove the company leaders are lying. In the final scenes, the crooks try to silence them, but Hank uses his toughness to fight back. The police arrive just in time to arrest the executives for their fraud and cover-up. Jim is found, the bad guys go to jail, and Hank gets a fresh start in life with Audrey by his side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school crime mysteries and underdog stories.
